## Setup - load packages and folder structure
```{r, message=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

# load required packages
library(ggplot2)
library(rgdal)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(here)

# set up folder paths
project.folder = paste0(here::here(), '/')
source(paste0(project.folder, 'create_folder_structure.R'))

```

## Prepare map structure
```{r}
theme_map = function(base_size = 8, base_family = "") {
  require(grid)
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) %+replace%
    theme(
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
      plot.background = element_blank(),
      legend.position = 'bottom'
    )
}
```

## Load Shapefile Data
```{r}
load_native_boundaries = function(project.folder) {
  us.main = readOGR(
    dsn = paste0(project.folder, "data/shapefiles/native_boundaries/"),
    layer = "tl_2020_us_aitsn",
    verbose = FALSE
  ) %>%
    spTransform(CRS("+proj=laea +lat_0=45 +lon_0=-100 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +a=6370997 +b=6370997 +units=m +no_defs"))

  us.main@data$GEOID = str_pad(as.character(us.main@data$GEOID), width = 7, side = "left", pad = "0")
  us.main@data$id = rownames(us.main@data)
  message("Loaded ", nrow(us.main@data), " native territories")
  return(us.main)
}
```

## Load Population Data
```{r}
load_population_data = function(project.folder) {
  # Use 2000-2025 folder but only keep years up to 2020
  pop.files = list.files(
    paste0(project.folder, "data/population/2000-2025/"),
    pattern = "\\.csv$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  pop.data <- map_df(pop.files, ~{
    read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE,
             col_types = cols(GEOID = col_character(),
                              population = col_double())) %>%
      mutate(year  = as.integer(str_extract(basename(.x), "\\d{4}")),
             GEOID = str_pad(GEOID, width = 7, side = "left", pad = "0"))
  })

  # Filter to only years up to 2020
  pop.data = pop.data %>% filter(year <= 2020)

  pop.data.wide = pop.data %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = year,
                values_from = population,
                names_prefix = "POP_")
}
```

## State Assignment
```{r}
assign_state_info = function(native_sp, shapefile.data, project.folder) {

  # Load states shapefile
  states_sf = st_read(
    paste0(project.folder, "data/shapefiles/states/states.shp"),
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  native_sf = st_as_sf(native_sp) %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(states_sf))
  native_sf = st_make_valid(native_sf)
  states_sf = st_make_valid(states_sf)

  # Calculate each territory's total area BEFORE intersection
  native_sf$territory_area = as.numeric(st_area(native_sf))

  # Compute geometric intersection
  intersections = st_intersection(native_sf, states_sf)

  intersections$intersection_area = as.numeric(st_area(intersections))

  intersections = intersections %>%
    mutate(area_proportion = intersection_area / territory_area)

  # Log how many intersections we found
  message("Raw intersections: ", nrow(intersections), " pieces across ",
          n_distinct(intersections$GEOID), " territories and ",
          n_distinct(intersections$STATE_NAME), " states")

# Remove intersections with near-zero area
  min_area_threshold = 1000  # square meters
  min_proportion_threshold = 0.01
  
  slivers = intersections %>%
    filter(intersection_area < min_area_threshold |
           area_proportion < min_proportion_threshold)
  
  intersections_clean = intersections %>%
    filter(intersection_area >= min_area_threshold,
           area_proportion >= min_proportion_threshold)

  # For each territory, find the PRIMARY state (largest area share)
  primary_state = intersections_clean %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(GEOID) %>%
    slice_max(area_proportion, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(GEOID, STATE_NAME, STATE_FIPS, area_proportion)

  multi_state = intersections_clean %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(GEOID) %>%
    mutate(n_states = n()) %>%
    ungroup()

  genuinely_multi = multi_state %>%
    filter(n_states > 1) %>%
    select(GEOID, STATE_NAME, area_proportion, n_states)

  native_sf_with_state = native_sf %>%
    left_join(
      primary_state %>% select(GEOID, STATE_NAME, STATE_FIPS),
      by = "GEOID"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      shapefile.data %>% select(GEOID, starts_with("POP_")),
      by = "GEOID"
    )

  state_lookup = primary_state %>%
    select(GEOID, STATE_NAME)

  message("\nAfter area-based assignment: ",
          nrow(state_lookup), " unique territories | ",
          n_distinct(state_lookup$STATE_NAME, na.rm = TRUE), " states")

  # Save the cleaned intersection data for potential later use
  saveRDS(intersections_clean %>% st_drop_geometry(),
          paste0(project.folder, "data/processed/territory_state_intersections.rds"))

  return(list(
    state_lookup = state_lookup,
    native_sf_with_state = native_sf_with_state,
    primary_state = primary_state
  ))
}
```

## Main Processing
```{r}
# Load data
us.main = load_native_boundaries(project.folder)
pop.data.wide = load_population_data(project.folder)

# Merge population with shapefile
shapefile.data = us.main@data %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  left_join(pop.data.wide, by = "GEOID") %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("POP_"), as.numeric))

message("Merged: ", nrow(shapefile.data), " rows | ",
        sum(!is.na(shapefile.data$POP_2020)), " with 2020 pop")

# Add state information using area-based assignment
state_results = assign_state_info(us.main, shapefile.data, project.folder)
native_sf_with_state = state_results$native_sf_with_state
state_lookup = state_results$state_lookup

shapefile.data = shapefile.data %>%
  left_join(state_lookup, by = "GEOID")

message("Final: ", sum(!is.na(shapefile.data$STATE_NAME)), " territories with states")
```

## Prepare Map Data
```{r, warning=FALSE}
map = fortify(us.main)
USA.df = merge(map, us.main@data, by = "id") %>%
  mutate(native_id = str_pad(as.character(GEOID), width = 7, side = "left", pad = "0"))
message("\nMap data prepared: ", nrow(USA.df), " polygon vertices")

## Save files
saveRDS(shapefile.data, paste0(project.folder, "data/processed/shapefile_data_all.rds"))
saveRDS(us.main, paste0(project.folder, "data/processed/us_main_shapefile.rds"))
saveRDS(USA.df, paste0(project.folder, "data/processed/usa_map_data.rds"))
saveRDS(state_results$primary_state, paste0(project.folder, "data/processed/primary_state_assignment.rds"))

# Also save state population summary
state_pop = native_sf_with_state %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(STATE_NAME)) %>%
  group_by(STATE_NAME) %>%
  summarise(
    total_pop = sum(POP_2020, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_territories = n_distinct(GEOID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_pop))

saveRDS(state_pop, paste0(project.folder, "data/processed/state_population_summary.rds"))

message("\nSaved all processed files!")
```

## Calculate Statistics
```{r}
# Summary statistics
territories_with_pop = sum(!is.na(shapefile.data$POP_2020) & shapefile.data$POP_2020 > 0)
territories_no_pop = sum(is.na(shapefile.data$POP_2020) | shapefile.data$POP_2020 == 0)

message("SUMMARY STATISTICS")
message("Total territories: ", nrow(shapefile.data))
message("Unique names: ", n_distinct(shapefile.data$NAME))
message("States with territories: ", n_distinct(state_lookup$STATE_NAME, na.rm = TRUE))
message("Total 2020 population: ", format(sum(shapefile.data$POP_2020, na.rm = TRUE), big.mark = ","))
message("Territories with pop > 0: ", territories_with_pop)
message("Territories with NA/zero pop: ", territories_no_pop)

# FUNCSTAT distribution
funcstat_counts = shapefile.data %>%
  group_by(FUNCSTAT) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    pop = sum(POP_2020, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Territory counts
name_counts = shapefile.data %>%
  count(NAME, sort = TRUE)

state_counts = shapefile.data %>%
  filter(!is.na(STATE_NAME)) %>%
  count(STATE_NAME, sort = TRUE)
```
